question.text: Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund is set up as an LVF for Accredited Investors under Cat III. By when must the LVF declare First Close, measured from the later of grant of registration or filing of PPM with SEBI?

explanation.text: The Logic: An LVF must declare First Close within 12 months from the date of grant of registration of the AIF OR the date of filing of the scheme PPM with SEBI, whichever is LATER. The Trap: Options A and B are too short. Option D extends the window beyond the workbook-prescribed period. Note: The clock starts on the later of the two events, so funds should track both the registration date and the PPM filing date carefully to compute the deadline.
